description: Snow Sports covers safe skiing, snowboarding and snowshoeing: hazards and cold-weather first aid, reporting accidents, trail markings, fitness, clothing and equipment, the Responsibility Code and avalanche safety, and one in-depth option.

safety.note: Ski and ride within your ability, follow the Responsibility Code, and never enter closed or avalanche-prone terrain.

versions.label: Checked against official scouting.org excerpts (partial verification)

provenance.notes: Requirement numbering and topics were checked against excerpts of official Scouting America pages (scouting.org) returned by a search index on 2026-10-24. The pages themselves could not be opened from the build environment, so wording was not compared word for word and some sub-items may be summarized from partial excerpts. Summaries are ScoutPath's own words. Requirement 7 offers four options — alpine skiing, cross-country skiing, snowboarding and snowshoeing — each with its own steps.
